li.label: the frost took my rows
li.description: I knew it was coming and we left the crop standing anyway. Now the leaves are black and the stalks fold over when you touch them.

li.label: lost one of the herd to the night
li.description: Something got under the gate in the dark and took one of the animals I look after. I keep counting them in the mornings now.

li.label: hunted animals running from a fire
li.description: They were running for their lives from the fire, and we shot them as they went past. The meat's in the smokehouse. I can't stop thinking about it.

li.label: we took in the burned-out family
li.description: A family burned out of their farm slept inside our walls last night, with a hot supper in them. Whatever came after them, at least they weren't out on the road.

li.label: we shut the gate on them
li.description: They'd been burned out of their home and walked all night, and we kept the gate shut. I watched them go down the road in the dark.

li.label: said goodbye to an old friend
li.description: Word came that someone from before the colony died, far away. We held a wake and I talked until late. Some of them laughed in the right places.

li.label: grieving someone far away
li.description: Someone I knew before the colony is dead, and buried where I can't go. The council gave me the day. I spent it walking.

li.label: planted a tree for them
li.description: Someone I knew before the colony died, far away. I planted a tree for them by the fields, with a stone beside it. I'll know where to go.

li.label: no time to grieve
li.description: Someone I knew before the colony died, far away, and the next morning I was back at work as if nothing happened. It's still sitting there.

li.label: got my old keepsake back
li.description: It turned up on a trader's blanket after all these years, and now it's mine again. I keep picking it up to check it's real.

li.label: my keepsake went down the road
li.description: It was right there on the trader's blanket, the one thing left from before, and now it's gone again. I should have done something.

li.label: said no to home
li.description: My family asked me to come home, and I wrote back that I'm needed here. I am. I keep reading their letter anyway.

li.label: sent silver home
li.description: The colony sent silver to my family instead of sending me. It will hire the help they need. It isn't the same as me being there, and they'll know that.

li.label: one of us went home
li.description: We walked them to the gate this morning and waved until the road bent. Their place at the table is still empty.

li.label: beat the gambler
li.description: A traveling gambler played me for the colony's silver, and I took the pot at the very end. My hands were shaking when I picked it up.

li.label: lost the colony's stake
li.description: The council trusted me with the stake, and the gambler went off down the road with it. I keep seeing the last game.
